checks.budget: 3 encoders * (256*16 + 128*16 + 256*32) = 43008 trajectories; 1920 inputs and 6 four-parameter fits.
checks.data_separation: New SHA256 names distinguish encoder, split, input/trajectory and rollout. Training-only pooled standardization; development descriptive. All six head records are hashed before any confirmation stream is opened.
checks.inference: Exactly 4000 paired hierarchical resamples conditional on three frozen encoders, .05 empirical quantile, lower endpoint>.02 and all three positive means; no coverage or new-seed superiority claim.
checks.native_extraction: Reviewed unmodified batch1 no_grad native forward and Torch count-trace recurrence; same final affine score is checked on every future registered trajectory. Native execution remains untested in this environment.
checks.native_source_identity: All three checkpoint SHA256, four original fit source identities, and proposal SHA256 match.
checks.numeric_failures: Each fit exception/nonconvergence is retained; missing/non-finite heads or failed gradient criterion prevent a scientific pass. No fitting retry or replacement confirmation.
checks.original_results: Original 0/6 multilayer gates and 91/92 finite-deadline gates remain unchanged.
checks.partial_cache: Within-shard failures save attempted stream identities, all completed arrays and a completion mask before rethrow. A run failure is recorded and existing outputs hashed. Every write refuses overwrite and >=480000 bytes.
checks.preflight_failure_scope: Version/publication checks precede run directory creation; CI provenance plus command/job logs retain these failures, rather than a nonexistent completed run manifest.
checks.python_ast: All 6 local Python source modules parsed.
checks.reproduction: Binds artifact hashes, source freeze and pre-confirmation head freeze, then recomputes development/confirmation risks and the same bootstrap without new native execution or fitting.
checks.risk: Both registered objectives use stable per-logit BCE and identical 0.001 weight regularization; deployed evaluation averages losses within each example, not features/probabilities.
checks.typed_json_contract: Freeze/request comparisons use canonical JSON bytes so JSON numbers 0/1 cannot alias boolean false/true through Python equality.
